name: lidar-surface
label: Lidar (surface, short range)
description: A scanning lidar on a vessel or at a quay: very fine plots, many per target, short range.
basis: Benchmark, Autoferry lidar: the settings of docs/examples/autoferry, with plot clustering. MHT, not GNN: two boats passing within metres swap under GNN (harbour gate 2.00% -> 1.51% wrong pairings, autoferry-4 pairing precision 79% -> 100%).
